$comment: Fleet server registry (#1351). Copy to fleet.config.json (or point FLEET_CONFIG_PATH at a copy elsewhere) to register vLLM servers without editing env vars. `models` is optional — the admin Servers tab and routing both read the live model list from each server's /v1/models endpoint, so you don't need to keep this file in sync every time a model changes. Add a server here (e.g. AWS, once "q"-gated routing exists) and it starts appearing in the admin Servers tab automatically once it serves traffic — no other code change needed.
